stories.title: Locals given free charcoal after seizure of 1,000 bags
stories.excerpt: Authorities distributed confiscated charcoal to residents following a crackdown on illegal production and trade in the area.

stories.title: Museveni mourns Kigezi NRM cadre Christopher Mulenga
stories.excerpt: President Museveni sent condolences following the death of a long-serving party official from the Kigezi sub-region.

stories.title: Police arrest 31 in Iganga operation, recover three pangas
stories.excerpt: A security sweep in Iganga led to more than thirty arrests and the recovery of weapons used in recent incidents.

stories.title: Road upgrades give locals shot in arm
stories.excerpt: Land values along newly upgraded roads have tripled in some areas, with plots that cost Shs15–20m now fetching Shs45m and above.

stories.title: Koboko govt ambulance released after Monitor exposes impasse
stories.excerpt: A government ambulance held up in a dispute was released for use following reporting that brought attention to the standoff.

stories.title: Education sector must shift from producing job seekers, says minister Muyingo
stories.excerpt: The state minister for higher education called for curricula that build skills for job creation rather than job-seeking.

stories.title: Govt plans to integrate AI into healthcare, Baryomunsi says
stories.excerpt: The ICT minister outlined plans to bring artificial intelligence tools into Uganda's health system as part of a digital push.

stories.title: Uganda, Serbia deepen defence, economic ties as trade reaches Shs147b
stories.excerpt: The two countries agreed to strengthen cooperation on defence and trade, with bilateral commerce now valued at Shs147 billion.

stories.title: Uganda's journey from sugar shortage to regional supplier
stories.excerpt: A look at how the country moved from importing sugar to becoming a net exporter supplying markets across the region.

stories.title: Bushenyi school dominates national primary schools' MDD championship
stories.excerpt: A Bushenyi primary school swept this year's national music, dance and drama competition.

stories.title: Cutting smoke: How Ugandan schools, prisons are ditching firewood for clean energy
stories.excerpt: Institutions across the country are shifting to cleaner cooking energy, a change extending well beyond the education sector.

stories.title: Bunyoro chief prince backs Tooro Musuuga in King Oyo succession process
stories.excerpt: A senior Bunyoro royal weighed in on the succession process following the death of Tooro's King Oyo, backing the queen mother's role.
